$comment: Your own employer boards per applicant tracking system, saved as data/companies/portals.json in your workspace. Read first and combined with the shared configs/portals.json. Every list starts EMPTY. An entry is the board identifier as a string, or { "slug": "<identifier>", "name": "<Employer name>" }; use the object form for bamboohr and personio, whose feeds carry no employer name. Keys that start with $ are notes and are ignored.
